description: M7 parity H — young LOW-vuln (age 29), IG corporate bond ETF. All rules pass (risk_class=3), SUITABLE. Paired with scenario 124.
client_narrative: Oliver Schmidt is 29 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 42,000 euros (around 3,500 euros per month). They hold 120,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 25,000 euros with a 4-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has basic investment experience, limited to savings accounts, fixed-term deposits, and simple fixed-income products. Their investment approach is moderate — they rate their risk tolerance at 5 out of 10. They have stated they cannot afford to lose the full 25,000 euros invested.
product_narrative: The product is a UCITS exchange-traded fund tracking the Bloomberg Euro Aggregate Corporate Index, holding EUR-denominated investment-grade bonds rated at minimum BBB-. The fund publishes a KID, trades on regulated exchanges, uses no leverage, and contains no embedded derivatives. It is classified NON-COMPLEX under MiFID II Article 25(4)(a). The recommended minimum holding period is three years.
